How it works

From photos to a storybook

Choose a story

Pick a classic tale. Each one has parts for your child and the people they love.

Cast your family

Add a photo of each person and choose who plays Little Red, Grandma, the woodcutter and more.

Meet your characters

We draw everyone in costume first. You approve them, and they appear on the book's opening page.

We draw, print and post

Every page is drawn from your approved characters, so they look the same throughout. Then we print your hardcover book.

Questions

Good to know

How do you put my family in the story?

You add an ordinary photo of each person and choose who plays which part. We first draw each of them as a story character in costume, in our hand-painted picture-book style. You check and approve these characters, and every page of the book is then drawn from them, so everyone looks the same from the first page to the last.

What is the “Meet the characters” page?

The first page of every book introduces the cast: each family member drawn in costume, with their name and the part they play. Children love finding everyone before the story starts.

Can I see my book before I pay?

Yes. You'll see your family drawn as characters for free before you order. After you order, a private link shows every page, you can ask for any picture to be drawn again, and nothing is printed until you approve it.

Does anyone in my family play the baddie?

Never. Villains such as the Wolf are always our own illustrated characters. Your family always take the good parts: the hero, the helpers and the clever grandparents.

Are these the Disney versions?

No. We write our own gentle retellings of the traditional tales, from the Brothers Grimm, Charles Perrault and Hans Christian Andersen, with our own pictures. In our Little Red Riding Hood, nobody gets eaten and Grandma outsmarts the Wolf.

What age are the books for?

About 3 to 7. The stories are written to be read aloud, with a rhythm that's fun for grown-ups too. For babies and toddlers, see our sister site Family Board Books.

What will the book be like?

A hardcover picture book of about 24 to 32 pages, printed in full colour on quality paper. We'll confirm the exact size, page count and price before ordering opens.

How much will it cost?

We'll announce prices when ordering opens. Founding families on our list get 15% off their first book.

Where are my photos stored?

In private, encrypted storage in the European Union, in Cloudflare's EU data centres. Your photos are never sent by email or kept in our shop system. Before a photo leaves your phone or computer, we shrink it and remove hidden details such as where it was taken.

Who can see my photos?

Only our automated system. Each book has its own secret key, and nobody on our team looks at your photos unless you ask us for help. To draw the characters, your photos are sent to our AI image provider under business terms that don't allow it to keep them or use them for training. Our printer only receives the finished print file.

How long do you keep my photos?

Free previews are deleted after 14 days if you don't order. Original photos are deleted once your book is printed. Pictures and the print file are deleted 30 days after delivery, unless you choose to keep them for reorders. You can delete everything yourself at any time. We never use your photos for advertising or to train AI.

Where do you deliver?

The UK and Europe. We'll confirm delivery times when ordering opens.
